description: Caddy base images, the caddy-dns/cloudflare plugin and the workflow's actions. Merging a PR rebuilds and pushes ghcr.io/2stacks/caddy-cloudflare; the stacks that use it get their digest PRs in their own repo. Validate every PR before merging: stable releases only, read the release notes, the PR build must pass. Every PR requests a review from 2stacks, which is how the owner gets mail (Dashboard edits send none); majors come as PRs too, with a warning in the body.

packageRules.description: Base images carry digests; digest PRs bring base-OS fixes
Builder and runtime base and the DNS plugin move together, so the image is rebuilt once
Major version bumps: a PR like any other (a review request mails the owner), with a warning in the body
prBodyNotes: **Major version:** read the upgrade guide and every breaking change before merging; the build must pass and the image must still serve the 8 Caddy stacks in homelab-admin. Don't want it? Close the PR: Renovate skips this major until a newer one appears.
